merchant/32167.htm.text: Trade Nika: Welcome! Are you looking for something special? I have more exquisite goods now than ever before, thanks to all these new people coming to the village. Just ask if there's something you need.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

Q00174_SupplyCheck/32167-01.html.text: Trader Nika: What is it? Do you have business here other than procuring supplies? If there's nothing in particular, please step aside. The next customer is waiting...

Q00174_SupplyCheck/32167-02.html.text: Trader Nika: Ah, Marcela sent you. Demand for goods has increased lately because of the opening of the island, and we have been sent scrambling to find enough supplies. In fact, we have even had to trade with the other races -- the capacity of the Dwarves to mobilize capital and material is particu…

Q00174_SupplyCheck/32167-03.html.text: Trader Nika: Please hurry to Marcela and give her my list. I hope she hears about my efforts to secure inventory...
